title: Patch: move the menus' remaining dialogs and sheets onto the shared Dialog
notes: The menus' dialogs and sheets draw through the one Dialog (R3221000): settings, friends and chat are its sheet, every other dialog closes by the ✕ at its top right, a question with a Cancel puts Cancel first, and Escape and Tab go to the top dialog alone. The inspect overlay's card detail (R2529000 counts apps/web/src/cards/ as how cards look) takes the same ✕ in place of its text Close, the dialogs' layer and their scrim's colour. How cards look only: nothing plays differently.

player.title: One kind of dialog on every screen
changes: Every menu's dialog closes the same way: by the ✕ at its top right, or by Cancel, now first, where it asks a question.
On a phone, Settings, Friends and a chat rise from the foot of the screen.
Escape and Back close the dialog on top alone, so a question asked over another dialog closes first.
